Sydney Sweeney betting ad sparks controversy over women's sports representation

An advertisement featuring actress Sydney Sweeney promoting a sports betting application has generated significant controversy. The ad, which shows Sweeney in a revealing outfit, has drawn criticism from female athletes who argue it undermines progress made in women's sports. Some coverage suggests the outrage itself might be part of a marketing strategy, with one outlet describing it as 'feminist-baiting'. The ad's impact on women's sports and its underlying PR playbook have been subjects of discussion.
